finalText:
**A small JSON API in five files, no package.json, no tests.**

```mermaid
graph LR
  server[server.js] --> auth[auth.js]
  server --> routes[routes.js]
  routes --> cache[cache.js]
  routes --> store[store.js]
  cache --> store
```

A request hits `server.js`, which checks the bearer token and rejects it with 401 if bad. Good ones go to `routes.js`, a small table of three endpoints. Reads go through `cache.js`, a 256-entry cache with no expiry. Writes go straight to `store.js`, an in-memory map where records die after 15 minutes.

One thing to know: `routes.js` says writes invalidate the cache, but `POST /orders` never clears `orders:<id>`. New orders stay hidden until the cache entry is pushed out.
